verdict.rationale: Missive's docs say you can connect Gmail, Outlook, Exchange, iCloud, or IMAP accounts, with Gmail getting full two-way label sync. Its IMAP/SMTP handling covers servers with untrusted certificates, and everything is managed in one shared inbox alongside SMS and WhatsApp. missing for 10: detailed documentation of how several simultaneous accounts are combined in a unified view, explicit naming of Microsoft 365 (docs say Outlook/Exchange), independent hands-on corroboration of multi-provider use

support.subject: As a switcher, I can connect several accounts across providers — Gmail, Microsoft 365, IMAP — and work them from one place

citations.quote: Connect Gmail, Outlook, Exchange, iCloud, or IMAP email accounts to Missive.
Connect Gmail or Google Workspace to Missive. Full two-way sync with labels.
Manage email, SMS, WhatsApp, and more in one shared inbox.
Connect to mail servers with untrusted certificates.
